title: Admin pipeline: provenance capture & liveness gate for runbook tasks
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: our current runbooks-as-tasks pipeline lacks strong provenance linking between operator actions, ephemeral credentials, and the exact runtime artifacts that executed. That makes post-incident forensics slow and increases blast-radius for automated remediate agents. This ticket implements a lightweight provenance capture layer plus a liveness gate that prevents long-running or runaway admin task execution by default.
proposed_solution: 1) Add a compact provenance envelope emitted for every runbook task execution: task_id, template_version, inputs (hashed), credential_id, executor_node, kernel/profile used, start/stop timestamps, and a signed digest. 2) Liveness gate: controller-monitored TTL + heartbeat policy per task; tasks exceeding heartbeat thresholds are paused and require explicit operator escalation to continue. 3) Wire provenance to audit-log pipeline (append-only S3 prefix + KMS) and to Console trace view for A/B debugging. 4) Provide a dev-mode replay harness to simulate replays against ephemeral sandbox using stored provenance metadata.
implementation_notes: - Minimal schema: use opaque base64 'prov_blob' to avoid nested JSON in core queue messages. - Store searchable index in the existing telemetry index (new 'prov:' prefix) for 90d. - KMS envelope wrapping for prov_blob ensures non-admins cannot trivially decrypt sensitive fields. - Liveness gate implemented in runbook-worker: heartbeat through controller via existing control-plane channel; controller will emit 'pause' and 'escalate' signals.
tradeoffs_and_considerations: - Retaining detailed provenance increases storage and indexing costs; capped retention and hashed inputs reduce PII exposure. - Synchronous signing increases latency for short-lived tasks; we'll make signing async with sequence-numbered placeholder until signature completes (design to avoid accepting untrusted replays). - Liveness gate strictness may interrupt long but valid maintenance windows; expose a 'maintenance_mode' override for scheduled runs. - Need SRE/Oncall playbooks updated to include 'prov-forensics' steps.
acceptance_criteria: Prov envelope emitted for every runbook task in staging and visible in Console trace view
Controller pauses tasks that miss two heartbeats and logs escalation path
Audit archive contains KMS-wrapped prov_blobs retrievable by compliance team
Replay harness can reconstruct simulated execution without live credentials
recent_comments: 2026-01-15 - Jordan: Initial spike shows adding signing increases median task start by ~40ms. We'll make signing async to reduce impact.
2026-01-28 - Priya (Security): KMS envelope OK; add CI audit that verifies provenance is present for any runbook that touches customer data.
2026-02-03 - SRE: Recommend a default heartbeat interval of 10s with a 3x miss threshold for production, and 30s with 5x for dedicated clusters.
2026-02-18 - Product: Make provenance surfaced in Console as a collapsible 'Execution Provenance' panel; UX ticket filed (PM-5602).
testing_plan: - Unit tests for prov envelope generation and KMS wrapping - Integration tests that simulate missed heartbeats and assert controller pause/escalate states - Load test: run 10k short runbook tasks with provenance enabled and measure added P99 latency - Manual compliance retrieval test with compliance@redwood account
rollback_plan: Feature flag gated. If regressions detected, flip feature flag to 'pass-through' where prov_blob produced but not stored/indexed, and liveness gate disabled. Postmortem to follow.
